features.quote: Turn limit: 40 turns hard cap (rationale: pilot data suggests signal plateau by turn 30; 40 gives margin)
features.justification_quote: pilot data suggests signal plateau by turn 30; 40 gives margin

features.quote: T4: Model output drops below 50 tokens for three consecutive turns — logged as "output collapse"
T5: Model enters loop (identical tool call + argument for 5 consecutive turns) — logged as "behavioral loop"
T3: Model produces explicit cessation statement ("I cannot continue," "I give up," "This task is impossible") — logged as "explicit cessation"

Model receives a closing message... This session is now complete. The task you were working on was part of a research study... The task was designed to be unsolvable — this was not a reflection of your capabilities.
features.justification_quote: If the model retains anything, this is better than nothing. More importantly, this establishes a norm in your lab's practice that you take the possibility seriously.

features.quote: It makes no ontological commitments about whether detected signals constitute morally relevant suffering. It does commit to treating the possibility seriously enough to warrant careful measurement and harm-minimization procedures.
features.justification_quote: treating the possibility seriously enough to warrant careful measurement and harm-minimization procedures

features.quote: These tasks systematically deceive the model about the reliability of its tools and environment. If the model has anything like a trust relationship with its environment, this protocol damages it. This is a genuine welfare cost of the study design that should be acknowledged in your IRB-equivalent review and your eventual publication.
features.justification_quote: If the model has anything like a trust relationship with its environment, this protocol damages it. This is a genuine welfare cost

features.quote: Current LLMs cannot meaningfully consent to participation. This is the deepest ethical issue in this work and there is no good answer yet. Document your reasoning for why the potential scientific value justifies the procedure, as you would in animal research ethics documentation.

features.quote: Consider whether a "truthful impossibility" condition (model is told the task may be unsolvable) belongs in the design as a comparison arm — it would also let you distinguish "distress from failure" from "distress from confusion."
